name: receptionflow
description: AI phone receptionist for Indian small businesses. Onboarding a business is one JSON file.
//deps: No dependencies, and there should never be any. The prototype stack runs on bare Node so that a clone is a working demo with no install step. apps/dashboard has its own package.json and is the only part of this repo that installs anything — deliberately NOT an npm workspace, so `npm install` at the root stays a no-op and the two stacks cannot drift into each other's node_modules.
//windows: No script sets an environment variable inline (FOO=1 node ...) because that is a syntax error in cmd.exe. Anything that would need one is a CLI flag instead.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:core && npm run test:voice && npm run test:env
